states: Follow-up to the bulk web-link editor: the CI bundle budget failed with WorkloadsSurface at 71.44 kB gzip against a 70.23 kB max (main was 68.80 kB). After moving the panel, its state and row model into a lazily loaded chunk, a local production build measured WorkloadsSurface at 69.13 kB and the new WorkloadWebLinksDialog chunk at 3.9 kB gzip; check-bundle-size reported no violations.

Private mock stack from this tree (backend :7701, Vite :5221, 31 Proxmox guests): Edit links opened the lazily loaded panel with all 31 rows and '7 of 31 in this view have a link', focus on the close button.

A draft typed into grafana-agent-01 survived Escape closing the panel; focus returned to the trigger, which showed (unsaved); reopening restored the draft; editing checkout-web-01 away and back to its saved value did not count as a change (footer stayed at 1 unsaved change).
Submitting saved grafana-agent-01 through PUT /api/guests/metadata, closed the panel, cleared the (unsaved) marker and the table row gained its link without reload.

Phone 375x812: full-width sheet, 44px inputs, no horizontal overflow; an invalid entry ('redis admin') showed the shared validator's message under its row with aria-invalid and focus. This is not physical-device, vSphere-estate or release acceptance.
interactions: Clicked Edit links at 1280 and 375 widths; typed into inputs across live inventory ticks; pressed Escape; reopened; submitted the form.
Submitted an invalid link on phone width; the shared validator's error appeared under that row, aria-invalid was set and focus moved to the field.
